Name: Mr.Qi Baechu Portraits and Sprites
Author: IslaWashington
Description:
The portraits aren't my own; I simply tweaked them as well as added a few things to make them compatible with the Friendable Mr Qi mod! I got the portraits from https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17406. If you're curious as to where I found them, I simply changed a few things, like the color of the outfit and clothing, as well as him tipping his hat down to hide a blush. Its meant to be used with the Friendable Mr Qi mod but can be used for normal Mr Qi as well if you place it in your portatuire mod! as for the sprites the way i implemented them into the mod was if you open up the [CP] friendable Mr Qi mod and you open assets and then images, you can copy and paste into that folder and override the current ones, or if you want to be able to switch back and forth, simply rename the sprites and portraits! I personally changed it to Nyapu because then you can easily switch it on and off as well, and I changed the sprites to the alt version!

If you guys have any questions or you wanna make my sprites better (It is my very first time ever doing something like this, so he's a little clunky DX), feel free to do so! If you'd like to share with others, that's fine, but please don't take all the credit. If it's for your personal use, I don't care ^^
